screenshots.caption: The checksum failure affects the acknowledgment, while actual memory already contains the new bytes. The following read confirms them; a failed client result is not proof of an unperformed write.
All 35 concatenated bytes are accounted for: five discarded bytes, one accepted 28-byte frame and two truncated final bytes. Offsets are zero based and the actual raw frame remains downloadable.

observedTests.name: Actual app and restart
observedTests.observed: Ten actual executions passed; eight records remained after two explicit test deletions. Exact evidence and raw-frame exports, two normal exits and restart were verified.

observedTests.name: Original domain gates
observedTests.observed: 198 Python tests plus 13 isolated Tcl cases, 24 C++ tests, 22000 properties, three CTest groups and five TypeScript tests passed; original sanitizers, fuzzing and benchmarks remain separate hosted gates.

observedTests.name: Distribution and security
observedTests.observed: All five release files matched provider hashes and all 82 installed files stayed unchanged. Three main workflows and four actual raw CodeQL categories passed before publication.

visualReview.scope: All four final pages individually inspected at original resolution; exact installed synthetic screenshots and immutable code; no ordinary user data.
